risk_descriptions.Specific Description: The accident occurred on a road that slightly curved to the right prior to the crash site. According to the analysis, curved roads increase the visual and cognitive loading on drivers, especially those in the inside lane, which may contribute to delayed recognition of forward hazards such as a stopped vehicle.

The crash occurred in the late evening hours on a dark and unlit roadway. Reduced visibility increases the difficulty of judging distances and speeds, especially for a turning maneuver like the one Vehicle 1 was attempting. This nighttime condition likely contributed to the misjudgment by the driver of Vehicle 1.
